before: Candy collecting, local vendors, live music, food and a costume contest with prizes. Non-religious community/farmers-market event.
after: A community trick-or-treat with local vendors, live music, food and a costume contest.

before: A BOOzy night focused on bats, conservation and tequila with Tracy Aviary, UDWR, NHMU and Cocktail Collective.
after: Learn about bats and conservation over tequila cocktails with Tracy Aviary, wildlife specialists and Cocktail Collective.

before: Old-fashioned harvest activities, corn maze, rides and a separate nighttime haunted river hollow. Strong Cache Valley day-to-night anchor.
after: Old-fashioned harvest activities, a corn maze and rides by day, with a separate haunted river hollow after dark.

before: Niche but memorable; fun for crafty families with older kids. Class size may be limited.
after: Turn a doll into a Halloween decoration in a hands-on craft class.

before: Watch hundreds of riders move nearly 800 bison, with food, educational booths, games and a festival viewing area. Not Halloween-specific, but an extraordinary late-October Utah spectacle.
after: Watch riders move the island’s bison herd from a festival viewing area, with food, educational booths and games.

before: Real hospital setting; highly immersive and much more intense than family events. Clearly label as older-teen/adult, not family-friendly for little kids.
after: A haunted attraction in a former hospital with actor contact and intense scares. Choose your contact level when booking.

before: Free spooky-art stop featuring Halloween, death, spirits, goblins and other autumn/apparition themes; useful as a short date-night add-on. Opening reception encourages costumes.
after: An art exhibition exploring Halloween, spirits, goblins and autumn apparitions. Costumes are encouraged at the opening reception.

before: Full-scale Gothic ballet with Ballet West Orchestra, theatrical effects and Dracula spectacle. Recommended for ages 8+; one of the strongest major-performing-arts Halloween entries.
after: A Gothic ballet with live orchestra, theatrical effects and Dracula’s story on stage. Recommended for ages 8 and older.

before: Press-covered residential projection-mapping haunt with giant singing pumpkins, flying ghosts and dancing skeletons; featured by local TV and Good Morning America. Watch only: the official site still displays its 2025 schedule as of Sep. 30, 2026. Do not treat those dates as current.
after: A residential projection show with singing pumpkins, flying ghosts and dancing skeletons. This season’s operating dates are awaiting confirmation.

before: Halloween laser show with projected ghosts and a playlist spanning Haunted Mansion, Beetlejuice, Thriller, Ghostbusters and more. At the Christa McAuliffe Space Center; a distinctly different laser-show option from Clark Planetarium.
after: A Halloween laser show with projected ghosts and music from Haunted Mansion, Beetlejuice, Thriller and Ghostbusters.

before: One of Daybreak's heavily publicized themed homes; elaborate Beetlejuice display and an easy stop on a Daybreak house tour. Media-covered by Axios/Fox13 in prior seasons and present in current 2026 haunt listings.
after: An elaborate Beetlejuice-themed display at a private home in Daybreak. View from permitted public areas and respect neighboring homes.

before: Anime convention + itasha/custom-car show with cosplay, voice actors, vendors, live music and contests. Distinctive hybrid of anime convention and custom-car culture.
after: An anime convention and custom-car show with cosplay, voice actors, vendors, live music and contests.

before: Historic-site fall festival with crafts, food trucks, vendors and free children’s activities. Useful non-haunt Tooele option.
after: A fall festival at the historic grist mill, with crafts, food trucks, vendors and free children’s activities.

before: Four-acre haunted corn maze plus Zombie Apocalypse Laser Tag on a long-running family farm with an eight-acre corn maze and pumpkin patch. Nightmare Acres is recommended for roughly ages 12+; daytime farm activities are much gentler.
after: A haunted corn maze and zombie laser tag after dark, alongside daytime farm activities and pumpkin picking.

before: Halloween-season drag brunch with food, coffee, cocktails and performances in the converted historic Ogden bus depot. Other = guests under 18 are allowed only with a parent or legal guardian; Eventbrite does not impose an adults-only floor.
after: Drag performances, brunch, coffee and cocktails in Ogden’s converted historic bus depot. Guests under 18 need a parent or legal guardian.

before: Residential drive-through haunt with its own FM soundtrack, designed to be accessible for people who have difficulty walking through conventional displays. Charity/food-drive component; official site also maintains Facebook, TikTok and YouTube.
after: A drive-through residential haunt with an FM soundtrack and a food-drive component. Visitors can experience the display from their vehicle.

before: One of Utah's true extreme-haunt options because Level 5 is full-contact; lower tiers let mixed-tolerance groups choose their intensity. Five-ghost rating applies to Level 5 Ultimate Hands On: 18+ only, ID required; guests may be restrained, moved, bagged, kidnapped and separated. Lower-contact Levels 1–4 remain available.
after: Choose from five scare levels, from lower-contact experiences to the adults-only full-contact Level 5. At Level 5, actors may restrain, move or separate guests; ID is required.

before: Visit the event page for the program, tickets and the latest details.
after: A family fall gathering in Clearfield.

before: One of Utah's biggest fall destinations: corn maze, pumpkin fest, rides, games, food and nightly light/fireworks programming; Frightbelly's remains a separate haunt row. 60+ attractions; ages 3+ ticketed, 2 and under free.
after: A corn maze, pumpkin festival, rides, games, food and evening lights at Thanksgiving Point. Frightbelly’s haunted attractions have separate admission options.

before: Less-crowded Cornbelly's location with 30+ attractions, corn maze, train and u-pick pumpkin patch. Separate location from Lehi; generally positioned as the smaller/lower-price option.
after: A corn maze, train, u-pick pumpkin patch and more than 30 fall attractions at Cornbelly’s Spanish Fork location.

before: The long-running Crazy Corn Maze is now the centerpiece of Nightfall Halloween Park, with Fright Lights, games, treats and optional Night Stalkers. Night Stalkers already has its own scare-focused row; this captures the non-haunt/family side.
after: A corn maze, Halloween lights, games and treats at Nightfall Halloween Park. Night Stalkers is the park’s separate scare-focused experience.

before: Trails after dark, activities, live animal encounters, treats and costumes; very family-friendly. Possibly the best genuinely local Ogden family event.
after: Explore trails after dark with live animal encounters, activities, treats and costumes at Ogden Nature Center.

before: Very thematic Halloween-weekend option without requiring a formal costume-ball budget. Goth, darkwave, new wave, post-punk and industrial music.
after: A dance party with goth, darkwave, new wave, post-punk and industrial music.

before: Classic patch/maze/cider-donut atmosphere without Utah County drive. Strong north-of-SLC general fall option.
after: A pumpkin patch, corn maze and cider-donut outing at a working ranch north of Salt Lake City.

before: Daft Punk / Justice / French-house-inspired costume party; relatively affordable adult option. Advance tier ends Oct. 24.
after: A costume party with French house and disco inspired by Daft Punk and Justice.

before: Live hip-hop plus DJ/costume-party energy; cheaper than many large Halloween events. Early-bird inventory is limited. VIP dinner tables are also available: 4 guests $218 all-in or 6 guests $324 all-in, including Ortega's dinner and cheesecake for each guest.
after: Live hip-hop and DJs at a Halloween costume party. VIP tables include a dinner package.

before: Adult Halloween package with banquet food, costume contest, Monster Mash music, activities and 180 minutes of unlimited game play. Advertised as adults-only, but the listing does not state an explicit 18+ or 21+ admission floor; valid ID is required for alcohol service.
after: An adults-oriented Halloween evening with banquet food, a costume contest, music and three hours of game play. Ask the organizer about the minimum admission age; alcohol service requires valid ID.

before: A cluster of genuinely Halloween-specific ranger programs: haunted stars, bat detecting, werewolf hike, Monster Mash hike and telescope trick-or-treating. Highlights: Curse of Algol Oct. 10; Bat Bananza Oct. 16; Werewolf Walk Oct. 24; Monster Mash Shrub Shuffle + Halloween Star Party Oct. 31.
after: Ranger-led Halloween hikes, bat programs, constellation stories and telescope viewing at Dead Horse Point. Activities vary by date.

before: Ofrenda, live performances, crafts and snack. Separate from the larger UCCC event.
after: Celebrate Día de los Muertos with an ofrenda, live performances, crafts and a snack at Kearns Library.

before: Music, cultural performances, children’s activities, food, artisan vendors, giveaways and Catrina/Catrin costume contest. Strong Utah County cultural option.
after: Music, cultural performances, children’s activities, food, artisan vendors and a Catrina/Catrin costume contest at Riverwoods.

before: Traditional dance/music, food, drinks, art and hands-on activities. One of the stronger non-Ogden Día events.
after: Celebrate Día de los Muertos through traditional dance, music, art, food and hands-on activities.

before: Excellent family option because the scare level can be calibrated. One of the strongest Ogden-specific family Halloween picks.
after: An after-dark Dinosaur Park outing with Halloween decorations and different scare levels for visitors to choose from.

before: Utah Symphony performs the film score live with Hocus Pocus; costumes encouraged and Salt Lake performances add witch meet-and-greets/trivia. One of the clearest touring/concert-style Halloween events in Utah this year.
after: Watch Hocus Pocus while Utah Symphony performs its score live. Costumes are encouraged; Salt Lake performances also offer witch meet-and-greets and trivia.

before: Exactly the kind of less-obvious Halloween programming that makes the list feel thorough: contemporary-art museum Halloween bash. Other = adult-oriented museum Halloween event; the current listing does not state a specific 18+ or 21+ minimum.
after: A Halloween party at the Utah Museum of Contemporary Art. The event is oriented toward adults; ask the organizer about admission ages.

before: Half-mile immersive park with robots, characters, quests, light shows and games. Best as the paid anchor of the one Utah County day.
after: A half-mile interactive park with robots, characters, quests, light shows and games.

before: Popular city Halloween gathering with food trucks, trick-or-treating, activities and vendors.
after: A city Halloween gathering with food trucks, trick-or-treating, activities and vendors.

before: Element 11's Utah burner community historically held fall Decompression events; the 2010 Halloween-weekend edition had multiple DJ stages, art cars, fire/aerial/drum performance and 800+ attendees. Historical lead only. The archive confirms October Decompression events, but no 2026 Halloween revival was found.
after: A gathering rooted in Utah’s burner community, historically combining DJs, participatory art and performance. A current-season edition has not been announced.

before: Long-running, lower-key Lehi patch with lots of pumpkin varieties, small animals, corn play area and photo spots; no admission fee. Current statewide 2026 event coverage confirms the patch; hours can vary with harvest/weather.
after: Pick from a range of pumpkin varieties and explore small-animal, corn-play and photo areas at this Lehi farm. Admission is free; hours depend on harvest and weather.

before: Italian horror composer Fabio Frizzi performs his Lucio Fulci-oriented FRIZZI2FULCI concert program. A genuine touring horror-score concert rather than an ordinary October gig.
after: Italian horror composer Fabio Frizzi performs music associated with filmmaker Lucio Fulci in his FRIZZI2FULCI concert program.

before: Local vendors, food, bounce house, pumpkin painting and petting zoo; Hallmark-fall vibe. Good early-October bundle filler.
after: A fall market with local vendors, food, a bounce house, pumpkin painting and a petting zoo.

before: Simple but useful farm-market option: local produce, crafts, honey and Halloween-night-market atmosphere. Official site specifically labels Oct. 16 as Halloween Market.
after: A Halloween night market with local produce, crafts and honey at Lehi Farmers Market.

before: Six-building, multi-story industrial haunt with underground passages and major production value; Touch of Fear adds actor contact but is not an extreme full-contact tier. 2026 season opens Sep. 18 and runs select nights through Nov. 1.
after: An industrial haunted attraction spanning six buildings, multiple floors and underground passages. The optional Touch of Fear ticket adds actor contact.

before: Southern Utah's major outdoor scare attraction with cinematic sets, effects and live actors. Not recommended for children under 12; separate ticket from general farm admission.
after: An outdoor haunted attraction with staged sets, effects and live actors. Not recommended for children under 12; admission is separate from the farm’s daytime activities.

before: Daylight/low-scare tour through the Field of Screams sets without scare actors or nighttime effects. Good behind-the-scenes alternative for people who want the sets without the full haunt.
after: Tour the Field of Screams sets in daylight without scare actors or nighttime effects.

before: Two-story indoor haunted house in the former Fiesta Fun building; useful weather-independent Southern Utah haunt. Recommended 13+; ages 7 and under not permitted; 8–12 must be accompanied by an adult.
after: A two-story indoor haunt in the former Fiesta Fun building. Recommended for ages 13 and older; children 7 and under are not admitted, and ages 8–12 need an adult.

before: Not Halloween-specific, but a polished fall tasting experience close to Cottonwood Heights and useful for the broader fall guide. One-night seasonal dinner built around fall flavors.
after: A one-night tasting dinner built around autumn ingredients and flavors.

before: Strong close-to-home Halloween date-night option: five-course themed menu, take-home trick-or-treat bag and costume incentives. Costumes heavily encouraged; best costume wins a future gift card and guests are entered for additional gift-card drawings.
after: A five-course Halloween tasting menu with a take-home treat bag and costume incentives, including gift-card prizes.

before: Hocus Pocus plus two short ghost tours; surprisingly strong free city event. Bring a flashlight for the hill during ghost-tour segments.
after: Watch Hocus Pocus and join short ghost tours at Lindsey Gardens. Bring a flashlight for the hillside walks.

before: Strong mixed-age option because non-haunt fall activities are on site too. Good if a family wants both fall-festival and scary components.
after: Haunted attractions at Cornbelly’s Lehi location, with daytime fall activities available on the same site. Check which attractions your ticket includes.

before: Rides + Halloween atmosphere + haunted attractions makes admission feel like a full experience. Best for a full day; check haunt age/intensity individually.
after: Lagoon rides, Halloween decorations and haunted attractions in one park visit. Individual haunts have different age and intensity guidance.

before: Excellent value; glowing storybook environments and interactive storytelling. Weeknight is best value.
after: Glowing storybook environments and interactive storytelling inspired by Neverland at Red Butte Garden.

before: Best festive-shopping atmosphere; easy to tailor to time/budget. Weekdays reduce kid/crowd intensity.
after: Witch displays, seasonal shopping and Halloween activities throughout Gardner Village. Choose individual activities to fit your visit and budget.

before: Big-scale Halloween nightlife that genuinely runs late; expensive compared with smaller parties. Parking is separately ticketed; check current festival tier before purchase.
after: A Halloween electronic-music festival with late-night performances and costumes. Parking requires a separate ticket.

before: Cheap real historic-site paranormal investigation; only 40 participants per session. Bring flashlights/cameras/recorders if desired.
after: Investigate paranormal stories at a historic military site in a group limited to 40 participants. Bring a flashlight; cameras and recorders are optional.

before: Giant pumpkins are hollowed into boats and raced across the lake — exactly the kind of oddball fall spectacle this guide should capture. Confirm exact viewing/parking instructions before heading out.
after: Watch racers paddle across the lake in boats carved from giant pumpkins.

before: Seventh-generation farm with a large corn maze, 60+ pumpkin varieties, animals and 20+ daytime activities. Field of Fright remains separately listed; this captures the substantial daytime/general-admission experience.
after: A working-farm outing with a corn maze, dozens of pumpkin varieties, animals and daytime activities. Field of Fright is the separate nighttime haunt.

before: Long-running animated graveyard display synchronized to music; one of the Sandy home displays singled out by local media. Historically uses 99.9 FM for synchronized music; media-covered destination rather than a random neighborhood pin.
after: An animated residential graveyard display with synchronized music. Respect neighbors and follow posted viewing guidance.

before: Pumpkin patch, bounce house, games, pizza, bake sale and farm activities. Cheap, local, easy recommendation.
after: A community farm festival with pumpkins, a bounce house, games, pizza and a bake sale.

before: Hands-on mixology class making two Halloween cocktails; costumes encouraged. Lifelong Learning classes are 18+; only one seat remained when checked Sep. 30.
after: Make two Halloween cocktails in a hands-on mixology class. Costumes are encouraged; check registration availability.

before: 20–25 minute Provo River boat ride with 100+ carved pumpkins, pirate/spooky interactions and a family Halloween movie. Distinctive, low-scare Halloween date/family option; boats seat up to 35.
after: A 20–25 minute Provo River boat ride past carved pumpkins, with pirate and spooky encounters and a family Halloween movie.

before: Spook alley, games and trick-or-treating. Free all-ages library option.
after: An all-ages library Halloween gathering with a spook alley, games and trick-or-treating.

before: Not a haunt, but a strong Halloween-adjacent spectacle for motorsports families. Bring hearing protection for kids.
after: A Halloween-themed demolition derby with crashing vehicles and loud engines. Hearing protection is useful, especially for children.

before: 30–45 minute nighttime chairlift ride with light spooky theming, treats and hot chocolate; strong date-night option. Family-friendly but Sundance recommends kids 10+; dress warmly. Halloween ZipTour also runs Oct 16–17.
after: A 30–45 minute nighttime chairlift ride with light Halloween theming, treats and hot chocolate. Sundance recommends ages 10 and older; dress for cold mountain weather.

before: 30+ vendors with Halloween decor, gifts, treats, clothing, books, jewelry and other local goods. Good suburban-market option that isn't just a pumpkin patch.
after: Browse local vendors selling Halloween decor, gifts, treats, clothing, books and jewelry.

before: Family-accessible spooky storytelling with a built-in intensity ramp. Excellent free option; encore Oct. 30 at WSU Davis with new stories.
after: Spooky storytelling that builds in intensity, with gentler stories earlier in the program. The WSU Davis encore features a different set of stories.

before: A genuinely immersive Halloween dining/cocktail pop-up with custom décor, themed menu and cocktails; much more distinctive than a generic costume party. 21+ only. Reservation ticket does not include food or drinks; no refunds or transfers. Basement venue is stairs-only.
after: A themed Halloween cocktail and dining pop-up in a basement venue. Ages 21 and older; stairs are required. Reservation tickets exclude food and drinks and are nonrefundable.

before: 90-minute themed ride with costumed characters; great destination-style family option. Likely worth advance booking.
after: A 90-minute Halloween train ride with costumed characters aboard Heber Valley Railroad.

before: Large corn maze and family fall activities with a separate Field of Fear option after dark. Strong Weber County farm option.
after: A corn maze and family farm activities by day, with the separate Field of Fear haunt after dark.

before: Well-known Roy front-yard haunt with multiple themed rooms; has drawn regional media coverage and visitors for years. Media-covered home haunt; free public attraction.
after: A free front-yard haunt with multiple themed rooms at a private home in Roy. Follow posted viewing guidance and respect neighbors.

before: Large Sandy home haunt with multiple themed zones including witches, clowns and farm/Hell areas; singled out by Axios. Included because it meets the media-publicized residential-destination standard.
after: A residential haunt with witches, clowns and other themed zones at a private home in Sandy. Follow posted visitor guidance.

before: Destination-style wooded trail with midway/bonfire atmosphere. Outdoor/weather considerations.
after: An outdoor haunted trail through the woods, with a midway and bonfire atmosphere. Dress for the weather and uneven ground.

before: 13 wooded acres; best true scary-haunt option in the Ogden area. Good northern recommendation for scare-seekers.
after: An outdoor haunted attraction across 13 wooded acres, with scares intended for visitors who want an intense experience.

before: Ghostly craft, haunted I Spy, spooky snack and bravery test. Library-specific seasonal programming.
after: A library Halloween activity with crafts, haunted I Spy, a spooky snack and a bravery challenge.

before: Full-size pirate ship, firing cannons, singing skeletons and a walkthrough; grew from a front-yard display into a major Southern Utah Halloween tradition. Current 2026 local-media feature confirms operation; donations help sustain the display and support animal rescues.
after: An outdoor walkthrough with a full-size pirate ship, cannon effects and singing skeletons. Donations support the display and animal rescues.

before: One-hour walking tour of downtown Heber's ghost stories and history; a notable gap in the prior ghost-tour coverage. Family-friendly but not recommended for very small children; outdoor walking and some stairs.
after: A one-hour walking tour combining downtown Heber history with ghost stories. The route includes outdoor walking and some stairs and is not recommended for very young children.

before: Very complete family event: trick-or-treating, carnival, food trucks, entertainment, mad scientist demo. Strong Wasatch Back family recommendation.
after: Trick-or-treating, carnival activities, food trucks, entertainment and a mad-scientist demonstration at a city Halloween festival.

before: Full fall farm experience: pumpkin patch, hayrides, petting farm, slides, corn pit and games. Giant Pumpkin Drop already has its own row; Halloween Festival is Oct 31, 4–8 PM.
after: A pumpkin patch, hayrides, petting farm, slides, corn pit and games at Hee Haw Farms.

before: Giant pumpkins are dropped from height for a charity event — visual, destructive and very Halloween-season appropriate. Check Hee Haw Farms for farm-admission details closer to the event.
after: Watch giant pumpkins dropped from a height at a farm charity event. Check the admission options for access to other farm activities.

before: Guided walking tour through downtown Logan’s ghost stories and haunted-history sites. Family-friendly on paper, but not recommended for small children.
after: A guided walking tour through downtown Logan’s ghost stories and haunted-history sites. Not recommended for young children.

before: Hocus Pocus screening plus costume parade, trick-or-treat stations, photo ops and spooky pre-show entertainment. A genuine parade entry, not just a costume contest.
after: A Hocus Pocus screening with a costume parade, trick-or-treat stations, photo areas and pre-show entertainment.

before: Strong family-friendly Halloween light experience with immersive displays, interactive play and live entertainment; much gentler than a haunt. Officially branded Hogle Halloween: A Boo Lights Experience. Most animal habitats are dark/closed after hours; allow about 90 minutes. Eccles Express and carousel are $3.50 per ride. Costumes encouraged with zoo safety restrictions.
after: An after-hours zoo walk with Halloween lights, interactive activities and live entertainment. Allow about 90 minutes; most animal habitats are closed or dark, and rides cost extra.

before: Games, crafts, treats and an all-ages costume parade. Costume parade makes it stand out.
after: An all-ages library Halloween party with games, crafts, treats and a costume parade.

before: Strong costume-night option: horror-character performances, drag/burlesque, DJ and party atmosphere. GA includes all three performance sets.
after: Horror-character performances, drag, burlesque and a DJ at a costume-night party. General admission includes all three performance sets.

before: Large volunteer-run charity haunt with proceeds benefiting local nonprofit organizations. 2026 site currently says weekends in October without publishing specific dates; tickets are sold at the door by cash, Venmo or card.
after: A volunteer-run haunted attraction benefiting local nonprofits. Tickets are sold at the door by cash, Venmo or card.

before: One of the most explicitly Halloween-dog events: costume contest, pet vendors, food trucks, raffles, giveaways and photo ops. Raffle proceeds support a local dog rescue.
after: A dog-friendly Halloween gathering with a costume contest, pet vendors, food trucks, raffles and photos. Raffle proceeds support a local dog rescue.

before: Major Park City Halloween anchor; lots of costumes and dogs. Use free transit if possible; Main Street closes to traffic at 2 PM.
after: A Halloween gathering on Park City’s Main Street with costumed people and dogs. Main Street closes to traffic at 2 PM; transit can simplify arrival.

before: Affordable Utah County staple with hayride, pumpkin patch, petting zoo, corn/straw mazes, corn pit, slides and a kid-friendly haunted cave. Closed Sundays; pumpkins and concessions sold separately.
after: A farm outing with hayrides, pumpkins, animals, mazes, slides and a kid-friendly haunted cave. Closed Sundays; pumpkins and concessions cost extra.

before: Pumpkin patch plus seasonal farm attractions that turn into a horror-focused haunted maze after sunset. Regional media and Visit Cedar City both list it for 2026.
after: A pumpkin patch and farm activities by day, with a haunted maze after sunset.

before: Free-admission pumpkin patch with seasonal shop, wagon rides, slides/swings, bean pool and farm animals. A strong low-cost fall stop that was conspicuously absent from the original farm coverage.
after: A free-admission pumpkin patch with a seasonal shop, wagon rides, slides, a bean pool and farm animals.

before: Hay maze, slides, bounce houses, jump pad, corn pits, games and pumpkins. Ideal daytime half of a Midway bundle.
after: A daytime farm festival with a hay maze, slides, bounce houses, jump pad, corn pits, games and pumpkins.

before: One of the best true day-to-night bundle opportunities: dairy-farm fall festival becomes haunted after dark. Wear good walking shoes; weather exposure.
after: A haunted hayride at a dairy farm after dark. Wear walking shoes and dress for outdoor weather.

before: Major Draper Halloween complex: large pumpkin patch plus corn maze, Cornfield of Terror, Halloween Main Street, bounce/foam/ball-pit attractions, food vendors and live programming. Some Thriller Park attractions are family-friendly; specific late-night/party components can be 18+. This was a major original-list omission.
after: A pumpkin patch and Halloween park with a corn maze, haunted cornfield, themed Main Street, play areas, food vendors and live programming. Admission ages vary for late-night events.

before: Laser show set to Halloween music including Thriller, Ghostbusters and classical spooky standards. Good inexpensive museum/planetarium add-on; confirm that the ticket store is live before relying on a specific date.
after: A planetarium laser show set to Thriller, Ghostbusters and other Halloween music.

before: Touring psychic-medium show combining live audience readings of 'the other side' with humor. Not standard stand-up, but a strong spooky-comedy/unconventional fit; 21+.
after: A psychic-medium stage show combining audience readings with humor. Ages 21 and older.

before: Substantial Cache Valley fall destination with corn maze, courtyard, pumpkin patch, Haunted River Trail, Redneck River Ride and Spooky Barn Ride. Haunted attractions run Fridays and Saturdays; Halloween includes daytime not-so-scary Haunted River Trail.
after: A corn maze, pumpkin patch and farm rides in Cache Valley, with separate haunted attractions on Friday and Saturday nights.

before: Daytime, deliberately not-scary Halloween at the heritage village: trick-or-treating, costume parade, Story Telling Witch, creepy crawlies and Candy Cannon. Creature Encounters Saturdays only; good option for kids or a low-fright historical Halloween outing.
after: Daytime Halloween activities at a heritage village, including trick-or-treating, a costume parade, storytelling and the Candy Cannon. Creature Encounters take place on Saturdays.

before: Very affordable live Halloween-season theater in a restored historic venue. Not an independent film screening, but worth including because Murray Theater is doing strong seasonal programming.
after: A live production of Little Shop of Horrors in Murray’s restored historic theater, combining musical comedy with a carnivorous-plant story.

before: Daytime downtown trick-or-treating at 60+ participating businesses. 21st annual event; easy for families with younger children.
after: Daytime downtown trick-or-treating at more than 60 participating Logan businesses.

before: 16-acre Century Farm patch with 45+ pumpkin varieties and photo backdrops; a simple, genuinely local pumpkin-picking option. Closed Sundays.
after: Pick pumpkins from a 16-acre farm with more than 45 varieties and photo backdrops. Closed Sundays.

before: Community haunted woods with gentler early hours and a scarier evening trail; proceeds support child-abuse/domestic-violence prevention. Good value and unusually clear charity purpose.
after: A community haunted trail with gentler early sessions and scarier evening sessions. Proceeds support child-abuse and domestic-violence prevention.

before: Halloween market, villain photos/trick-or-treat, mechanical bull, bounce house, balloon animals and fire pits. Strengthens the existing University Place bundle.
after: A Halloween market with villain photos, trick-or-treating, a mechanical bull, bounce house, balloon animals and fire pits.

before: Good value because the corn maze is included; weather is the main downside. Weather-dependent.
after: An outdoor haunted trail with corn-maze admission included. Dress for the weather.

before: Polished multi-attraction haunt; strong choice for older teens who actively want scares. Not a little-kid recommendation.
after: A multi-attraction haunted house with intense scares aimed at visitors who enjoy horror. Not recommended for young children.

before: Hundreds of haunted clowns and dolls across neighboring yards; longstanding media-covered destination that has collected large Utah Food Bank donations. Keep as a watch item until a fresh 2026 operating post appears.
after: A residential Halloween display with haunted clowns and dolls across neighboring yards. Current-season operating dates are awaiting confirmation.

before: Blind-box horror/thriller/cult screening; excellent art-house style addition because the movie title stays secret. Members Voice Pick on Oct. 25; screening title is intentionally not announced.
after: A mystery horror, thriller or cult-film screening where the title stays secret until the event.

before: Straightforward non-religious city/community trunk-or-treat with local businesses. Bring a candy bag; costumes optional.
after: A community trunk-or-treat with local businesses. Bring a candy bag; costumes are optional.

before: The clearest 21+ Ogden Halloween nightlife option: multiple bars, costume crowd, drink/food specials, photographers and after-party. 21+ with government-issued ID. Participating venues can change; rideshare strongly recommended.
after: A multi-venue Halloween bar crawl with costumes, drink and food specials, photos and an after-party. Ages 21 and older with government-issued ID; participating venues may change.

before: One of the clearest Ogden-specific spooky-history options. Private October tours require 10+ guests.
after: Explore Historic 25th Street’s ghost stories on a guided walk through downtown Ogden. Private October tours require at least 10 guests.

before: Strong northern farm addition: live western music, agriculture demos, animals, local farms/makers and farm-sourced food. Argyle Acres lists 3–7 PM; Visit Ogden's displayed time appears inconsistent. Community listings identify the event as free.
after: A farm festival with western music, agriculture demonstrations, animals, local makers and farm-sourced food.

before: City trucks, DJ, face painting, straw-bale slide, photo ops and costumes. Non-religious municipal event.
after: Explore city trucks alongside a DJ, face painting, a straw-bale slide, photo areas and costumes.

before: One of the later-running Halloween-night options; tech-house / techno focus and big costume energy. Price/end time currently supported by local event listings; verify primary ticket page before purchase.
after: A late-night Halloween dance event focused on tech-house and techno.

before: Best evening anchor for a Park City bundle; history-heavy rather than jump-scare haunt. Good fit for older children who enjoy stories/history.
after: A guided evening walk through Park City history and ghost stories, with an emphasis on storytelling rather than staged jump scares.

before: About 7 miles linking ~20 mining structures; free way to add substance to a Park City day. Could cherry-pick a shorter section rather than walk all 7 miles.
after: A self-guided route linking mining structures around Park City. The full route is about seven miles; visitors can choose a shorter section.

before: A pagan community market with artisans, makers, jewelry, food, musicians and explicitly magical/pagan community framing. Official event page describes it as a pagan community vendor show.
